heading: Lunar Connector
subtitle: Check, install, repair or remove the Windows connector.
ids_draft_hint: Development build: copy the 32-letter ID from player setup; separate multiple IDs with spaces or commas.
ids_official_hint: Official extension IDs are prefilled. Saved IDs are retained for repair.
notice: Installs for your Windows user without administrator access. Then choose Agree and enable in player setup and check the connection. Uninstall keeps bookmarks, wallpapers and homepage settings.
installed_hint: Installation checks passed. Check the live connection in player setup.
not_installed_hint: Review the extension IDs, then choose Install.
needs_repair_hint: Files, version or browser registration need attention. Choose Repair / update.
details_idle: Operation results appear here. Opening this tool only checks installation status.
invalid_id: Enter the 32-letter extension ID from player setup (lowercase a–p). Separate multiple IDs with spaces or commas.
uninstall_confirm: Remove the Windows connector? Its processes, installed files and registration will be removed. Your homepage data will be kept.
uninstall_done: Uninstalled. Keep this EXE to install again later.
install_done: Done. Installation checks passed. Check the connection on your homepage.
incomplete: Finished, but some checks still need attention. See the details below.
operation_failed: Operation did not complete. Review the details and try again.
link_failed: Open this address in your browser:
details_scroll: Scroll with the mouse wheel or arrow keys. Select and copy text with Ctrl+A and Ctrl+C.
